description: `prose --output json rm` prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope whose suggestedArgv is `cli program delete --help`, and the Action names `cli job delete`.

problem.action: A job is deleted with `cli job delete JOB_ID`. Use `cli program delete SLUG`; `prose --output json cli program delete --help` shows its arguments.

details.reason: `rm` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli program delete --help`? Runs are never deleted; a saved program is deleted with `cli program delete SLUG` and a job with `cli job delete JOB_ID`. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
